summary:
ORBITAL FLAME INTELLIGENCE (OFI) is an independent AI-powered scientific research intelligence platform focused on microgravity combustion and space fire safety research.

The platform aims to simplify the discovery, exploration, visualization, and interpretation of combustion experiments conducted in microgravity environments. It brings research exploration, experimental data visualization, investigation comparison, and AI-assisted scientific analysis into one unified interface.

Its AI assistant, FLARE AI (Fire & Laboratory Analysis Research Engine), is designed to help users understand combustion research, interpret available experimental data, and discover relevant scientific information while maintaining scientific transparency and source attribution.

By making complex combustion research more accessible and easier to analyze, OFI aims to support scientific learning, experimental understanding, and future research into spacecraft fire safety.

Tagline: UNDERSTANDING FIRE. BEYOND GRAVITY.
details: ORBITAL FLAME INTELLIGENCE (OFI) UNDERSTANDING FIRE. BEYOND GRAVITY. Project Overview ORBITAL FLAME INTELLIGENCE (OFI) is an AI-powered scientific research intelligence platform designed to explore, analyze, visualize, and interpret microgravity combustion experiments. It aims to make complex scientific research more accessible while supporting a better understanding of flame behaviour and fire safety in space environments. The Problem Combustion behaves differently in microgravity than on Earth. Changes in buoyancy, convection, flame structure, heat transfer, and smoke formation create unique challenges for spacecraft fire safety. However, large volumes of experimental research data can be difficult to discover, compare, visualize, and interpret. Our Solution OFI provides a unified digital platform that brings combustion research, experimental data exploration, scientific visualizations, and AI-assisted analysis together. Key Features 1. Research Explorer: Discover and organize scientific investigations and research resources. 2. Combustion Intelligence: Explore flame behaviour and combustion characteristics. 3. Visualization Lab: Present experimental measurements through interactive charts and visualizations. 4. Experiment Comparison: Compare compatible experimental conditions and research findings. 5. FLARE AI: An AI research assistant (Fire & Laboratory Analysis Research Engine) designed to explain scientific concepts, summarize research, and assist with experimental data interpretation. 6. Research Library: Organize scientific information and references. NASA Open Data The project focuses on publicly available NASA Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) resources, particularly microgravity combustion investigations such as FLEX, Saffire, ACME, BASS, and SPICE. These investigations provide valuable research context for studying flame extinction, flame spread, smoke formation, and combustion behaviour in space. Actual dataset integration and analysis are identified separately from planned capabilities. Technology Stack Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Recharts, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Python, Pandas, and the Z.ai GLM API. Expected Impact OFI aims to simplify access to microgravity combustion research, improve experimental data exploration, support scientific learning, and contribute to research understanding relevant to future spacecraft fire safety. Future Vision Our vision is to develop OFI into a comprehensive scientific intelligence platform connecting space research, experimental data analytics, and AI-assisted scientific discovery. Project Identity: ORBITAL FLAME INTELLIGENCE (OFI) AI Assistant: FLARE AI Tagline: UNDERSTANDING FIRE. BEYOND GRAVITY.
